transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I've been struggling with really bad sleep problems and constant anxiety for about a year and two months now. I just can't seem to stop worrying, and it's making it impossible to get any rest. It's gotten to the point where I really need some help.
Did these anxiety and sleep problems start after a specific stressful life event or major change, or did they come on without one? If there was a stressor, is it still going on?

I'm not really sure of any specific stressful event or major change that triggered all of this. It seems like these feelings and sleep issues just developed gradually over time, without one clear cause.
Along with the anxiety, have you been feeling down or depressed most days, or losing interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy? If so, has that been happening for at least two weeks?

No, I wouldn't say I've been feeling down or losing interest in the things I enjoy. My main issue is really just the constant anxiety and worry that I can't seem to turn off. It's more about feeling wound up and anxious all the time rather than feeling depressed.
Do you find yourself worrying about many different parts of life, like work, health, finances, or family, rather than mainly about one specific problem? Is it hard to control the worry?

Yes, my worry isn't just about one thing; it spreads to everything from my job and finances to my family's well-being. Once those anxious thoughts start, I find it incredibly difficult to stop or control them, no matter how hard I try to distract myself.
Over the past 6 months, have you also had symptoms like feeling restless or on edge, getting tired easily, trouble concentrating, muscle tension, or irritability?

Yes, I've actually felt this way for over a year now. I feel completely wound up like a tight spring, and my whole body is so stiff and tense that I just can't relax. I don't really notice being irritable or easily fatigued, but my nerves are constantly on edge.
